title: Bill 110 street improvement exemption for Front Street rebuilds
summary: On November 7, 2025, an amendment to Bill 110 passed eight to zero. It extended the exemption to three properties just north of Baker Street. The bill gives targeted relief to owners whose buildings the August 2023 wildfires destroyed or badly damaged, and a property manager testified that street improvement requirements are a costly barrier to rebuilding.
